description: This PHP class 'LDAPDao' provides data access methods for LDAP-related operations within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the database to fetch users, employees, and LDAP authentication provider information, specifically tailored for LDAP authentication and synchronization features.

classes.name: LDAPDao
classes.description: Data access object for LDAP-related database operations, extending from BaseDao to utilize common DAO functionalities.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers associated with multiple users (more than one user linked to the same employee).

methods.name: getNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a non-local LDAP user by username, specifically for LDAP-authenticated users with no local password.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a user by username, including local users.

methods.name: getAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP authentication provider details by the LDAP user’s unique ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Searches for an employee based on various filter parameters such as employee number, employee ID, email, etc.

methods.name: getAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all LDAP authentication providers configured in the system.

methods.name: saveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Saves LDAP synchronization status information to the database.

methods.name: getLastLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Fetches the most recent LDAP synchronization status record.
